title: NTA JIPMAT 2026 Answer Key -Out
intro: National Testing Agency (NTA) has Officially Released Answer Key for the IIM Jammu & IIM Bodh Gaya Join Integrated Management Admission Test JIPMAT 2026.Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to NTA JIMPAT 2026 Admission. Exam Held On June 7, 2026 & Answer Key Released On June 10, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Download Answer KeyNow in the Given Link Below.
